chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a male slave marrying four free women. He said: No, but he may marry two free women, and if he wishes, he may marry four female slaves.
ai.seo_question: How many wives can a male slave marry according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar clarifies the specific marital restrictions for a male slave (abd), distinguishing between the number of free wives (limited to two) and female slaves (up to four). It reflects the Shia juristic view that a slave's capacity to maintain multiple marriages is constrained by his status, ensuring he can fulfill the rights of his wives without the burden exceeding his means, a nuance often discussed in contrast to the general permission for free men in Surah An-Nisa.
